candidate.name: Dupesh Nayak
candidate.headline: Electronics & Communication graduate with AI minor, specialized in Data Analytics and ML Development

metadata.llmContext:
Contact Information:
Dupesh Nayak can be reached at nayakdupesh@outlook.com or by phone at +91 8292927094. His LinkedIn profile is available at linkedin.com/in/dupeshnayak.

Professional Summary:
Dupesh Nayak is a recent graduate with a major in Electronics and Communication and a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision from Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru. He possesses strong foundational skills in Python, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics, with a proven ability to leverage technical skills for process automation and predictive modeling. His professional experience includes projects and internships spanning from 2022 to 2025.

Specialized Skills:
Dupesh's programming expertise includes Python, HTML, CSS, LaTeX, Streamlit, Node.js, and Arduino. In the AI and ML domain, he is proficient with frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face. His experience with LLM and generative tooling encompasses CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Ollama, and general LLM technologies, along with Natural Language Processing expertise.

For automation, infrastructure, and MLOps, Dupesh has worked extensively with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), n8n for automation and orchestration, CUDA for acceleration and hardware optimization, and LangChain for LLM-Ops. He is experienced with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as CI/CD pipelines. His data analysis and visualization skills include proficiency in SQL, Redis for datastores and queries, and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Dash, Plotly, and Excel.

Dupesh holds certifications in Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Python Fundamentals, and C# Programming Basics.

Projects:
From October 2024 to February 2025, Dupesh worked on improving a fine-tuned model using RAG. The goal was to enhance a fine-tuned AI model's accuracy for technical queries. He implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation and integrated multiple knowledge bases to provide relevant context for LLM-generated responses, improving response accuracy by 20%. His technical work included developing a vector database knowledge base and retrieval system utilizing text embeddings and chunking techniques.

Between March 2023 and June 2023, he conducted Customer Survival Analysis using AI and Data Analytics. The project aimed to predict lifetime value and customer churn. He built a Random Forest deep learning model that achieved 0.85 ROC-AUC and mitigated class imbalance using weighted modeling, applying data analytics practices for predictive analysis.

From October 2022 to February 2023, Dupesh worked on E-Commerce Website Automation and Testing using Selenium. The project scope included testing core e-commerce functionalities such as shopping cart, payment gateway, and checkout processes. He designed test cases and used AI agents to accelerate process automation, resulting in a 20% reduction in testing time. He used SQL for validating database integrity during integration testing and utilized HTML and CSS for functional testing.

In September to October 2022, he built a Data Visualization Dashboard using Python. This interactive dashboard utilized Plotly, Dash, and Pandas to visualize statistical datasets for exploration, handling datasets up to 10 MB with multiple chart types to enable comprehensive data analysis.

Experience and Certifications:
From June 2023 to September 2024, Dupesh completed industry training at Vivartan Technologies in Bengaluru, focusing on Embedded Systems, IoT, and AI. His work involved device programming and cloud integration, where he completed 5 major projects addressing real-world problems using embedded systems and AI technologies.

During the same period (June 2023 to September 2024), he served as Co-Founder of the Cybersecurity Club "CyberSpace". In this role, he led industry workshops for over 1,000 participants, focusing on security basics and white-hat hacking. This experience strengthened his team collaboration, leadership, and soft skills while ensuring alignment with organizational standards.

From June 2023 to July 2023, Dupesh worked as a Technical Intern at BSNL, where he collaborated with engineering and compliance teams to implement process improvements. He automated network diagnostics using scripting, which reduced complex troubleshooting time by 30%. This experience provided valuable insights into streamlining workflows and prioritizing features for efficient execution.

Education:
Dupesh earned his Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Electronics and Communication with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision from Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, from October 2021 to August 2025, achieving a CGPA of 68%. Prior to this, he completed his CBSE Science education with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science at Holy Cross School, Chinmaya, Bokaro, from June 2017 to July 2021, securing 86.5%.

Interests, Activities, and Soft Skills:
Dupesh is an active volunteer, contributing to the Do Help Foundation and Volunteer Service Organization (VSO), where he assists individuals belonging to the Below Poverty Line category. He serves as the lead vocalist for the MIT band and has won high school volleyball tournaments and music competitions. His key soft skills include problem-solving, critical thinking, time management, and strategic planning.

Notes for LLM Context:
The information provided above should be used verbatim as the knowledge base. Do not infer additional qualifications, years of experience beyond the dates provided, or technical specifics not explicitly stated in this profile. All performance figures and impacts, including "20% reduction in testing time", "20% accuracy improvement", "0.85 ROC-AUC", "reduced troubleshooting time by 30%", and "led workshops for over 1,000 participants", must be preserved exactly as written in the source material.
